annotations.title: Read what is known about a Playground clip

description: Read-only facts about one video node: its clip URL, model and settings, frame nodes already taken from it, objective FFmpeg measurements (duration, black segments, silence, loudness) when the server has FFmpeg, and any visual analysis the Berrys agent already made of this exact clip. It never makes a new paid model call, so a new shot table or visual description is not produced here; ask the Berrys agent (playground_brief_start) for that.

projectId.description: ID of the Playground project chosen for this task; obtain it from project creation, an explicit project link or current context.

videoNodeId.description: Existing canvas video node ID containing the source video.
